# Vibetail

> Turn your current vibe into a personalized cocktail. AI-powered cocktail generator that translates moods, feelings, and flavors into bespoke drink recipes.

Vibetail asks how your night is actually going, then mixes one drink for it. The flow is five short steps — vibe, texture, strength, base spirit, notes — one question per screen, with a running "order" panel you can jump around. The result is a printable specimen card: name, recipe, tasting notes, and a diagnosis you didn't ask for. Partner bars can run the same flow against their own published menu so guests are matched to a drink that's actually pourable tonight.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page — what Vibetail is, how it works, the specimen cards, partnerships, team and FAQ.
- [Mix a Vibe](/mood-input): The five-step mixing flow. Each step is linkable via `?step=1..5`.
- [Vibe Bar](/gallery): Your saved cocktails, filed as a catalogue.
- [Mood cocktail recipes](/guides/mood-cocktail-recipes): Guide of 12 mood-matched recipes.

The app is English-only.
